_comment: Suite directories that no runner executes, declared explicitly.
A directory listed here is NOT passing. It is not running at all. The distinction
matters: an unrun suite and a green one are indistinguishable in a summary line,
and that ambiguity is the defect this whole repo exists to remove.
tools/run_conformance.py fails on any uncovered directory that is NOT listed here,
and also fails on a stale entry (a directory listed here that has since gained a
suite.json). The list has to stay true to be worth having.
To clear an entry: add a suite.json declaring adapter.cmd + vectors.path (see
conformance/tee-inference-v0/ for the four-file shape), then remove it from here.
undeclared_vectors: a suite.json points at ONE vectors file. Other vector files in
the same directory are run by no manifest. Listing them here is an admission that
they are unrun in CI, not a claim that they pass. Clearing this needs multi-vector
manifest support (suite.json declaring a list) — a schema change for the WG, not a
runner change. Until then these files are exercised only by hand.
requires_live: suites that cannot run hermetically — they need an external binary on
PATH, or a live HTTP call to infrastructure we operate. They are SKIPPED by CI, not
passed. A suite whose green depends on our own service being reachable is measuring
our uptime as much as the claim, so it must not contribute to a CI pass.

requires_live.reason: gate.ts shells out to foundry `cast` for keccak AND makes a live MCP call to gateway.ensub.org. Intentional as a live-capability lane (it checks a running capability still returns the pinned bytes) but not hermetic: it cannot be reproduced by a third party without our gateway up, and CI has neither cast nor a reason to depend on our uptime.
